subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Total Cost of Ownership
description: A 60-second lesson on Total Cost of Ownership.

hook.text: A supplier offers the lowest price per unit. But after shipping, storage, and defect rates, they're the most expensive.

buildup.text: Total cost of ownership (TCO) adds all costs beyond the purchase price: transport, handling, storage, and risk.

discovery.text: TCO reveals the true cost of inventory decisions—a cheap item with high holding costs may cost more overall.

twist.text: Most procurement teams still optimize on unit price alone. TCO thinking requires cross-functional collaboration.

climax.text: Companies that adopt TCO-based purchasing reduce total supply chain costs by 5–15% on average.

punchline.text: The cheapest item isn't the lowest cost. Look at the total.

quiz.question: What does TCO include beyond purchase price?
options: Transport, handling, storage, and risk costs
